applicability.primary_chapter: Chapter II - Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale

decision_policy.APPLICABLE: Required scope conditions are satisfied and no applicable exclusion is established.
decision_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: An applicable exclusion is definitely established.
decision_policy.NEEDS_VERIFICATION: Available product information is insufficient to determine applicability.

rules.requirement: A commodity must not be pre-packed for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package or securely affixed label bears the declarations required by the Rules.
rules.failure_condition: A required declaration is definitely established as absent from a clear image.

rules.requirement: The package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer. Where the manufacturer is not the packer, the manufacturer and packer name and address must be mentioned. For imported packages, the importer name and address must be mentioned.
rules.failure_condition: Required identity/address information is definitely absent and the applicable role is known.

rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be mentioned.
rules.failure_condition: The applicable commodity identity is definitely absent from a sufficiently clear image.

rules.requirement: The net quantity must be declared in the standard unit of weight or measure, or the number of commodities where the commodity is packed or sold by number.
rules.failure_condition: Net quantity is definitely absent from a sufficiently clear image.

rules.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, pre-packed or imported must be mentioned.
rules.failure_condition: The applicable date declaration is definitely absent and no exception applies.

rules.requirement: The retail sale price of the package must be declared.
rules.failure_condition: MRP is definitely absent where the declaration is applicable.

rules.requirement: Where the size/dimensions of the commodity are relevant, the dimensions of the commodity must be mentioned.
rules.failure_condition: Dimensions are definitely absent where the condition makes the declaration applicable.

rules.requirement: Other matters specifically required by the Rules must also be declared.
rules.failure_condition: A category-specific declaration is definitely absent after applicability has been established.

rules.requirement: The package must bear the name, address, telephone number and, if available, email address of the person or office that can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
rules.failure_condition: Required consumer-contact information is definitely absent from a clear image.

rules.requirement: Declarations on the principal display panel must meet the prescribed minimum letter and numeral height requirements.
rules.failure_condition: Required size can be reliably measured and is below the applicable minimum.

rules.requirement: Every declaration required under the Rules must appear on the principal display panel.
rules.failure_condition: Location/spacing can be reliably established as non-compliant.

rules.requirement: Declarations must be legible and prominent.
rules.failure_condition: Legibility/contrast can be reliably established as non-compliant.

rules.requirement: Where a package has an outside container or wrapper, the outside container/wrapper must also contain the required declarations.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable wrapper declarations are definitely absent.

rules.requirement: The particulars of declarations required under the rule must be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English.
rules.failure_condition: Required declarations are clearly provided only in a language that does not satisfy the rule.

rules.requirement: The package must conspicuously bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or manufacturer and packer where they are different, and importer details for imported packages.
rules.failure_condition: Required identity/address information is definitely absent where applicable.

rules.requirement: The manufacturer, packer or importer name must be the actual corporate name or the name under which the business is conducted in India.
rules.failure_condition: Cannot be established reliably from label image alone.

rules.requirement: The declared net quantity must exclude wrappers and other packaging material.
rules.failure_condition: Cannot establish actual physical quantity from label image alone.

rules.requirement: The quantity must be expressed using the appropriate unit of weight, measure or number.
rules.failure_condition: The unit is clearly inappropriate for the applicable commodity and no exception applies.

rules.requirement: The quantity declaration must not contain words or expressions that create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression about quantity.
rules.failure_condition: A prohibited/misleading quantity expression is confidently identified.

rules.requirement: Units of weight, measure or number must follow the units prescribed by the Rule.
rules.failure_condition: The unit format clearly violates the applicable provision.

rules.requirement: Specified textile and similar commodities must declare the number and finished dimensions.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable dimensions are definitely absent.

rules.requirement: Where dimensions and/or weight have a relationship to price, the relevant dimensions or weight must be declared.
rules.failure_condition: Applicability cannot be established reliably from image alone.

rules.requirement: Sheet-type commodities must state the number of usable sheets and dimensions of each sheet.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable sheet count/dimensions are definitely absent.

rules.requirement: Container-type commodities must declare quantity and applicable dimensions.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable quantity/dimensions are definitely absent.

rules.requirement: A wholesale package must bear the applicable manufacturer/importer/packer identity, commodity identity and quantity declarations.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable wholesale declarations are definitely absent.

rules.requirement: An export package must be repacked or relabeled according to Chapter II before being sold in India.
rules.failure_condition: Cannot be established from label image alone.

rules.requirement: Certain specified packages may be exempt from the Rules subject to the conditions in the rule.
rules.failure_condition: An exemption is incorrectly applied when the package does not satisfy the rule.

rules.requirement: An advertisement mentioning retail sale price must contain the required net quantity or number declaration.
rules.failure_condition: Applicable advertisement declaration is definitely absent.

status_policy.PASS: Required information is clearly detected and applicable automated validation succeeds.
status_policy.FAIL: Use only when the applicable requirement is definitely absent or definitely violated and evidence is sufficient.
status_policy.NEEDS_VERIFICATION: Use when OCR is uncertain, image quality is insufficient, applicability is uncertain, or manual verification is required.
status_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: Use when the rule does not apply to the product.
status_policy.IMPORTANT: Missing OCR text alone must never automatically produce FAIL.
